scope: A2 controlled author-data comparison (corrected MIFlu / no-text / NLinear / naive) on the author 966-row data
seed_note: first three of the frozen 10-seed list [42..51]; NOT chosen by result inspection
selection_metric: average_MSE_4L = mean(mse_all) over L in {24,36,48,60}; seven-variable, full-horizon, z-space
selection_objective: best VALIDATION MSE per (horizon, seed); Test evaluated once, after training

scaling.scheme: per-variable StandardScaler fit on TRAIN rows only (population std ddof=0, +1e-8, float32) + per-window instance norm (RevIN)

optimizer: adam (betas 0.9/0.999, eps 1e-8), lr 5e-4, weight_decay 0.0, no scheduler, no grad clip
repetitions: 3 seeds x 1 rep (NOT the 10-rep paper protocol; A2 is a minimum comparison, not a 10-rep reproduction)
test_exposure: Test is NOT read during training or selection; no early stopping on Test; no Test-based seed choice
no_text_definition: no_multi variant = use_text=False, LoRA kept, prompt_cache=None -> single zero token. Removes the entire text pathway; sequence length and patch positions change. This is a WHOLE-PATHWAY contrast, not a matched-length content control; a same-length scrambled-text control is OPTIONAL and separate from the 36-fit minimum.
